== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Escalon Company is a mid-level interplanetary corporation. While it maintains various business interests, including a tattoo parlor, its physical headquarters is described as having a dilapidated appearance similar to a run-down loan office. The organization has been linked to illegal activities such as smuggling and the manufacturing of weapons, leading to arrest warrants for its president, [[Jak Escalon]]. The company's history is marked by controversy; its founder, [[Omega]], was a violent individual responsible for massacres, and the [[revelation]] of his identity caused many associates to abandon the firm. The company is currently led by Jak, who is considered ill-suited for his role in power, and the founder's family maintains significant control over him.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Escalon Company was originally founded by [[Omega]], who was once shackled to the organization by [[Aila Escalon]]. The company's diverse interests included ownership of a tattoo parlor, and its resources were utilized by [[Omal]] to hire violent criminals. Currently, the President of the Escalon Company is present on the planet.}}
